title: Harden editor preview rig/skinner component ownership across reloads
description:
## Summary
The preview root is structurally identified with an EntityId, but `CreatureRig` and `CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer` previously relied on `GetComponent`/`AddComponent` while each component kept private generated-object state. Rapid editor recompilation/domain reloads could therefore leave stale duplicate components or orphaned generated children.

## Scope
- Extend the existing structural ownership pattern from the preview root/geometry children to the preview's rig and skinned-renderer components.
- Before rebinding, discover all owned `CreatureRig` and `CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer` components on the preview root, clear each one's generated objects, retain exactly one live component of each type, and remove extras.
- Do not use global name searches.
- Preserve the preview root's external objects/components and source mesh.
- Ensure clear/rebuild is idempotent and leaves exactly one rig/skinner pair.
- Add focused editor tests for duplicate-component recovery where Unity allows.

## Non-goals
- Do not redesign `CreatureRig` ownership globally.
- Do not add per-frame checks.
- Do not add another preview root identity system.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Rebinding a recovered preview with duplicate rig/skinner components produces exactly one active `CreatureRig` and one `CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer`.
- Generated rig bones/renderer objects owned by removed duplicates are cleaned up rather than orphaned.
- Existing structural ownership and teardown remain intact.
- No per-frame allocation or lookup is introduced; this is bind/reload-time only.

## Validation
Focused Editor/PlayMode lifecycle test with forced rebind/recovery; inspect hierarchy for one rig/skinner pair and no orphaned generated bones/renderer objects.

## Status
InProgress — source hardening landed; focused Unity validation remains the closure gate.

## Implementation evidence
`CreaturePreviewController.GetSingleOwnedComponent<T>` now scans all owned components of each preview rig/skin type, clears their generated state, retains one deterministic component, and destroys duplicates during bind/clear only. No per-frame path uses this helper.

comments.body: Follow-up bug fix for live regeneration failure. Root cause: ApplyPreviewGeometry called GetSingleOwnedComponent<CreatureRig>() after BindImplicitSurface; that helper cleared generated state on the retained rig before checking RestSkeleton, producing "Preview rig must be built before mesh-asset geometry is attached." Fix in Assets/Scripts/Editor/CreaturePreviewController.cs adds a non-destructive lookup mode and uses it only for the post-bind attachment lookup; cleanup/rebind calls retain destructive reconciliation. Validation: dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Editor.csproj --no-restore passed with 0 errors/warnings; get_errors reported no errors. Unity EditMode fixture could not run because the MCP connection could not connect to Unity, so live first-build/rebuild/delete-rebuild evidence remains outstanding.
